messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — tenant 'acme-inc' reported a sharp latency + 429 spike this morning. Their traffic mostly omits X-API-Version header and is getting routed to v1, which has a lower per-tenant quota. Any quick wins?

josh: Oof. Do we have telemetry partitioned by header-present vs header-missing?

maria: Not currently. We only surface per-route quotas and total rejected_by_quota. The tenant owner shared a short trace where route->v1 and then queued -> reject.

oliver: Short-term: we can add a derived metric: routing.header_present:{true,false} and a count for header_missing routed_to:{v1,v2}. That should show prevalence.

sabrina: Agree. Also UX idea: console route detail page could show a tiny breakdown: % requests with explicit version header. Helps tenants debug.

maria: +1. For mitigation: can we make missing-header routing use tenant affinity history (route to the variant the tenant usually hits) instead of defaulting to v1? That would avoid cold fallbacks.

josh: That's feasible. Policy change: lookup last_n(tenant, route) -> preferred_variant. If none, then fallback to current default. Edge: cold tenants still ambiguous.

oliver: Implementation note: keep it opt-in via flag first. We should also emit a safety metric for 'inferred_variant != header_variant' to catch mis-inferences.

sabrina: UX/permission: add a per-tenant console toggle "prefer inferred variant for missing header" (off by default). Product agreed to let SRE enable for pilot tenants.

maria: To be clear on quota semantics — if we infer and route to v2 which has higher per-tenant qps, billing/quotas should follow the actual served variant. Need ops sign-off.

josh: Yup. Quota system already tags by served_variant, so that aligns. But we should avoid accidental quota inflation on a wide roll. Recommend shadow mode first: route inference happens but quota/billing still use original routing.

deploy-bot: Flag "infer-version-from-affinity" deployed to staging (canary=5%) by @oliver.

oliver: For telemetry instrument: emit metrics: 
- routing.header_present (bool)
- routing.inferred_variant (string)
- routing.infer_confidence (0-1)
- routing.infer_applied (bool)
- routing.infer_shadow_count (int)
Tag by tenant_id, route, region.

sabrina: I'll mock a console panel layout: small bar chart showing header_present %, inferred_variant distribution, and a one-click "enable inference" for that tenant (with audit log).

maria: Plan: 1) oliver lands telemetry + shadow routing in staging. 2) josh runs a 48h pilot on acme-inc in shadow mode. 3) sabrina ships console affordance behind feature flag. 4) ops reviews quota impact before flip.

josh: I'll own the pilot and the rollback playbook. If we see >5% unexpected variant mismatch, we stop.

maria: Thanks. Can everyone add short PR/issue links here when ready. Also we should add an alert: alert if header_missing_pct_by_tenant > 20% and reject_rate increases.

oliver: Created issue: https://internal/issue/INF-2387 — contains telemetry + inference design notes.

sabrina: Created mock: https://internal/designs/INF-2387-console-panel (will link PR when ready).

maria: Awesome. I'll schedule a 15m sync after pilot starts. :thumbsup:
